• Grant microphone access in System Settings

• Restart the app after granting permissions

analyticsModal.privacyBody: Analytics is off by default. When enabled, it collects anonymous usage data only. Meeting content, names, file paths, and personal information are never collected.
analyticsModal.modelsItems: Transcription model (for example, Whisper large-v3 or Parakeet)|Summary model (for example, Llama 3.2 or Claude Sonnet)|Model provider (for example, Local, Ollama, or OpenRouter)
analyticsModal.modelsReason: Helps us understand which models users prefer
analyticsModal.metricsItems: Recording duration|Pause duration|Number of transcript segments|Number of audio chunks processed
analyticsModal.metricsReason: Helps us optimize performance and understand usage patterns
analyticsModal.devicesItems: Microphone type: Bluetooth, Wired, or Unknown|System audio type: Bluetooth, Wired, or Unknown
analyticsModal.devicesReason: Helps us improve compatibility without collecting actual device names
analyticsModal.usageItems: App started and stopped events|Session duration|Feature usage|Error occurrences that help us fix bugs
analyticsModal.usageReason: Helps us improve the user experience
analyticsModal.platformItems: Operating system, such as macOS or Windows|App version|Architecture, such as x86_64 or aarch64
analyticsModal.notCollectedItems: Meeting names or titles|File names, file paths, or meeting folders|Meeting transcripts or content|Audio recordings|Device names|Personal information|Any identifiable data
